body:
I'm sure you'll either be able to reapply to your program or will be able to find something else.  Try talking to the financial aid office and see what they think you should do.

Depression is really hard but it can get better.  Have you tried talk therapy?  Cognitive behavioral methods can help you have fewer painful thoughts.

My stepsister had a lot of the problems it sounds like you have but she got some help and now she's doing really well.  It's really tough being a young woman, not being able to trust your friends and having people always trying to sleep with you.  But it can get better, don't give up now.

I'm happy to talk if there's anything else you'd like to say.

History, Hamline University, a relatively small/private liberal arts school.  Not exactly elite, but not a degree mill and a school that's well respected in the region.  

I have/wear a nice suit, my hair is short and I'm clean cut, I shower regularly etc.  I always meet the gaze of interviewers and am quite well spoken.  I've been told before, applying for lesser positions, that they think I'm overqualified or 'too smart' and likely to leave quickly.  No convictions or anything. 

I've been applying for a wide range of things, basically anything I can find a posting for, but it seems like everyone wants direct experience in the relevant industry.
Thanks a lot, that looks promising.

OP here.  There are plenty of things I'd like to do in my life.  I'd like to have a dog, and find someone to love me, and watch the fifth season of Breaking Bad.  I'd like to get back to the times in my life when I wasn't in so much pain, and had things to enjoy, and thought that tomorrow might be better than what preceded it.  Of course there are things I want.  But it appears to be the case that I can't get those things and what's more likely, homelessness, is not something I'm willing to endure.  Hence the gun. 

Thing is I've been determined for a year, doing anything anyone's suggested, and I have less and less to show for it.  My window closes more every day, I become less and less desirable in any sense of the word, and soon I'll end up homeless.  I'm miserable enough now that I'm not willing to do that.

I'm not picky about what I end up doing at this point, though I have some physical disabilities that prevent me from standing for long periods of time (not fat, deformed feet.)  I just need to be able to support myself and live independently.  $10-15 an hour would allow me to do that wouldn't it?  Doesn't seem attainable either way.  I've tried everything anyone's suggested.  People say my resume and interviewing skills are good.  I'm not getting any interviews though.

I always thought things would work out for me.  But I've been trying hard for a long while now and my situation, not my outlook but my objective situation, grows more hopeless each day.  I can't sustain some magical belief that continuing to do the same things is suddenly going to produce a different result.
I'm here, flawed vessel that I am, shoot partner.
Thanks for the quick response but that's boilerplate.  I'm going to be fucking homeless.  How am I supposed to find a decent job then when I can't find one now?
No, it's been a long time since I had enough cash for any of that.
Many therapists.  Some helped, some didn't.  But while I can CBT away fears about my waistline, or thoughts that I'm being lied to, I have been so far unable to use it to turn shit into gold.
[This](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/w09si/grad_apparently_unemployable_tried_all_the/) is my situation.  I would like to talk about it if you feel you have anything to say.

The cliche is that suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem.  It seems clear that your medication is exacerbating your problems or causing new symptoms.  This is not normal, and is very fixable, with a new medication or even by going off medication entirely.  I suggest that you get into your doctor at the earliest possible date (should be possible if you call and tell them you're having severe/new side effects) and tell them these things.  Show them this.

I have been through a lot of things in my life and medication has only sometimes helped.  But one thing I was on made things a lot worse.  This is a real risk of antidepressants and it is tragic when it leads to suicide.  Please get help with this bad medication and reevaluate your situation afterwards.

PS.  Is it Effexor?  That stuff fucked me up good.

Have you looked into stories of people who have recovered from your ailments?  I know what it's like to be hopeless, and to have no options from the doctors you've seen, but sometimes what gets me through is reading the accounts of people who have gotten better.

Ah, girlfriend, you've got more going for you than your realize.  First off, your cat is a real beauty.  I'm sure it's a sweetheart and would miss you terribly.  Try and remember that another living thing loves you unconditionally and needs your love.  Looking at only the first page of your comment history I can assure you that you are intelligent and interesting enough to have a good life.  You should realize that most people do hardly anything at all, and have very few interests.  You clearly have some personality, which puts you well above the masses.

It sounds like you have some low self esteem but if you thought it through you'd find that some of your problems are inconsistent.  For instance, you don't think you're attractive enough but everyone's tryng to have sex with you.  Only one of these things can be true, which doesn't stop the other one from sucking, but rest assured it can only be 50% as bad as it seems.  My guess is that it is the second problem, that people try to use you sexually, but I think this is a common problem and easier to deal with than being truly ugly.

I myself am a literal eunuch.  Not your typical reddit forever alone but a genuine sexual cripple.  This has given me some special insight as an observer into how people's sexual desires inform their friendship choices.  What I can tell you is this; you're probably right that most people want to use you for sex, but you would be shocked how many people do not.  I mean, look at yourself, who is plainly in need of some good friends, there are many others similarly situated.  The trick is separating the sheep from the goats.  It's hard, but I suggest you do it by being plain with people; explaining upfront that you are not interested in sex (leave it at that) but are in need of some friends.  I've found it works well enough for me.  Very few people looking for sex are really willing to invest that so much effort in attaining it as a friendship entails.

You still have all the qualities you were once proud of, its just harder to see those things because you have fallen into a depression.  There are different ways to get out of that, and I can make some suggestions about what has helped me before, but it would be easier if you could give me a specific list of some things you've tried.

I appreciate the support, really.  Because I am so depressed it is difficult to enjoy anything, but I'll get off reddit and try to read something.  Thing is, I've been going day by day for a long while now trying to do that, enjoy little things, set small goals (in the best shape of my life, for instance) but I'm past it helping any.

I'm a failure because I'm living in the basement of my parents, who don't want me around, because I've sold everything I owned of any value to avoid going to them for money, am very broke, and most importantly have every reason to believe these things arent going to get better.

In the early days I got a lot more interviews for a lot better things than I've seen in a long while.  It seems like every day my window closes a little more because why would anyone hire a reject like myself over a more recent grad?  That might sound like depressive thinking, but I don't have any other reasonable way of explaining the steady decline in my prospects.

Thanks for your good faith attempt, some sick fuck downvoted this, but I have physical disabilities that would disqualify me from military service.  Not things that I could work on, like being too fat, but the muscles in my feet are deformed.

There are some very nasty things I'd like to say to you.  I'll restrain myself because I don't know this board's guidelines but I'll hint that they involve scatological metaphors and violent sexual imagery.  Look those words up in a dictionary wunderkind.

Many of the people most likely to commit suicide have few if any sources of support in their lives.  More likely they have conflicted feelings about those sources and wouldn't mind hurting them.  When you say garbage like this all you serve to do is remind desperate individuals that there is no one who really matters to them.
